Upper Text: [On Play][When Digivolving] Place 1 [Raijinmon], 1 [Fuijinmon], and 1 [Suijinmon] from your trash under this Digimon in any order as its bottom digivolution cards. Gain 1 memory for each card placed.[When Attacking] If the level 6 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards have 3 or more colors among them, this Digimon gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn. If they have 4 or more colors, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
